items.title: 7.5 Khinche hue taar par stationary waves (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.5 with Fig. 7.7 and Example 7.3 (PDF 147-150); equation (7.4) is printed twice.

blocks.text: Lambai l ka ek taar lein jo apne siron ko jakar kar khincha rakha gaya hai, ta ke taar mein tension F ho.
(a) Taar ko darmiyani nuqte se chherna

Agar taar ko us ke darmiyani nuqte se chhera jaye to is nuqte se do transverse waves nikalti hain, ek baen sire ki taraf aur doosri daen sire ki taraf. Jab yeh waves dono jakre siron tak pohanchti hain to wapas mur (reflect ho) jati hain aur stationary waves banati hain. Chunke taar ke dono sire jakre hain, wahan koi harkat nahi hoti, to dono siron par nodes bante hain, aur taar ka ek vibration mode Fig. 7.7(a) jaisa hai, dono sire nodes aur beech mein ek antinode; dekhne mein taar ek loop mein vibrate karta lagta hai. Chunke do lagataar nodes ka faasla taar mein bani waves ki aadhi wavelength hai, is mode mein taar ki lambai l = lambda1/2, ya lambda1 = 2l ... (7.2), jahan lambda1 is mode mein bani waves ki wavelength hai.

blocks.alt: Do deewaron ke darmiyan jakra lambai l ka taar ek loop mein jhoolta hai (thos aur dashed curves), Single loop, dono siron par node N aur beech mein antinode A; neeche l = lambda1/2.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.7(a): Vibration ka pehla mode (kitab ki Figure 7.7(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Taar mein waves ki speed v taar ke tension F aur m, taar ki fi unit lambai mass, par munhasir hai; yeh us nuqte se azaad hai jahan se taar chhera jaye: v = sqrt(F/m) ... (7.3). Speed v aur wavelength lambda1 jaan kar waves ki frequency f1 = v/lambda1 = v/2l; v ki qeemat rakhne par f1 = (1/2l) sqrt(F/m) ... (7.4). Yun vibration ke pehle mode (Fig. 7.7a) mein diye gaye taar mein sirf frequency f1 ki waves banti hain.
(b) Taar ko chauthai lambai par chherna

Agar wohi taar us ki lambai ke ek chauthai se chhera jaye to phir stationary waves banti hain, nodes aur antinodes Fig. 7.7(b) jaise; ab taar do loops mein vibrate karta hai. Yeh soorat is liye banti hai ke taar antinode ki jagah se chhera gaya. Chunke do lagataar nodes ka faasla aadhi wavelength hai, taar ki lambai l is mode ki waves ki wavelength ke barabar hai: agar lambda2 un ki wavelength ho to l = lambda2/2 + lambda2/2 = 2 (lambda2/2), to lambda2 = l (print mein phir (7.4) number). Is soorat mein wavelength pehli soorat ki aadhi hai, aur chunke waves ki speed tension aur fi unit lambai mass par munhasir hai, chherne ki jagah se azaad, v dono sooraton mein ek hi rehti hai. Agar doosre mode mein vibration ki frequency f2 ho to f2 = v/lambda2 = v/l; 2 se zarb aur taqseem karne par f2 = 2v/2l, aur chunke f1 = v/2l, f2 = 2 f1. Yun jab taar do loops mein vibrate kare to us ki frequency ek loop wali se dugni ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab lambda2 = l ko phir number (7.4) deti hai, jo pehle hi f1 = (1/2l) sqrt(F/m) ko mil chuka hai; is ka naya number hona chahiye. Kitab yeh bhi likhti hai ke 'Eq. (7.2)' batati hai ke speed tension par munhasir hai; speed wali equation v = sqrt(F/m) asal mein Eq. (7.3) hai.

blocks.alt: Wohi jakra taar do loops mein jhoolta hai, Double loop: dono siron aur beech mein node N, har loop mein antinode A; neeche l = lambda2 = 2(lambda2/2).
blocks.caption: Figure 7.7(b): Vibration ka doosra mode (kitab ki Figure 7.7(b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Do lagataar nodes ka faasla aadhi wavelength hai. Ek loop mein l = lambda1/2; do loops mein l = 2(lambda2/2) = lambda2. Isi liye doosre mode ki frequency pehle ki dugni hai: f2 = 2f1.
(c) Taar ko kisi bhi nuqte se chherna

Maan lein taar n loops mein resonate karta hai, (n + 1) nodes aur n antinodes ke saath. Agar taar n loops mein vibrate kare to us par bani stationary waves ki frequency fn = n (v/2l), ya fn = n f1 ... (7.5), to fn n ke tanasub mein hai, aur mutabiq wavelength lambda_n = 2l/n ... (7.6), jahan n = 1, 2, 3, ... Jaise jaise taar zyada loops mein vibrate kare us ki frequency f barhti jati hai aur wavelength lambda usi hisab se chhoti; magar f aur lambda ka hasil-e-zarb hamesha waves ki speed v ke barabar rehta hai.

items: Stationary waves ki frequencies ka ek alag alag (discrete) set f1, 2f1, 3f1, ..., nf1 hai, jise harmonic series kehte hain. Vibration ki sab se kam khaas frequency fundamental frequency f1 hai, jo first harmonic hai; frequency f2 = 2f1 second harmonic hai, waghaira.

Doosre lafzon mein resonance frequencies ke darmiyan frequency mein quantum chhalangein hain; ise frequencies ki quantization kehte hain: fn = n f1, jahan n = 1, 2, 3, ... (poore mazrab). Taar par stationary waves sirf harmonic series ki un frequencies par ban sakti hain jo taar ke tension, lambai aur fi unit lambai mass se tay hon; jo waves harmonic series mein na hon woh jaldi dam tor (damp ho) jati hain.

Musical instrument ke taar ki frequency tension badal kar ya lambai badal kar badli ja sakti hai. Misal ke taur par guitar aur violin ke taaron ka tension instrument ki gardan par khoontiyan (pegs) kas kar badla jata hai; instrument tune hone ke baad musician gardan par ungliyan chala kar, yaani taar ke vibrate karte hisse ki lambai badal kar, frequency badalte hain.

blocks.text: Upar ki misal mein tamam mumkin standing waves ka set, jin ki frequencies f1, 2f1, 3f1, ..., nf1 hain, system ke harmonics kehlata hai. Tamam harmonics mein sab se kam ya bunyadi frequency fundamental ya first harmonic kehlati hai; agli frequencies second harmonic, third harmonic, waghaira kehlati hain.

blocks.title: Example 7.3
blocks.text: 120 cm lambe, dono siron se jakre taar mein stationary wave bani hai. Taar 120 Hz frequency par chaar hisson (segments) mein vibrate karta hai. Us ki wavelength aur fundamental frequency nikalein. Hal: l = 120 cm = 1.2 m, n = 4, f4 = 120 Hz, f1 = ?, lambda = ?. (i) Chunke taar chaar hisson mein vibrate karta hai aur do lagataar nodes ka faasla lambda/2 hai, l = n (lambda_n/2), to lambda_n = 2l/n, lambda4 = 2 x 1.2/4 = 0.6 m. (ii) Agar taar n loops mein vibrate kare to stationary waves ki frequency fn = n f1: f4 = 4 f1, 120 = 4 f1, f1 = 120/4 = 30 Hz.

blocks.prompt: Taar par wave ki speed 24 m s^-1 hai; agar us ki lambai 6.0 m ho to kaunsi driving frequency use resonate karati hai? 0.75 m guitar ke taar ki sab se kam resonance frequency 400 Hz hai; wave speed nikalein. Steel ka taar (qutr 0.50 mm, lambai 1.5 m, density 7.8 x 10^3 kg m^-3) 80 N uthata hai; us ka fundamental nikalein (numerical 7.1, 7.2, 7.4).

items: Khincha taar, jakre sire nodes. Darmiyan se chherna: ek loop, l = lambda1/2, v = sqrt(F/m), f1 = (1/2l) sqrt(F/m). Chauthai se: do loops, lambda2 = l, f2 = 2 f1. n loops: n + 1 nodes, fn = n f1, lambda_n = 2l/n; f lambda = v hamesha.
Harmonic series f1, 2f1, 3f1, ...; frequency ki quantization; tension (pegs) ya lambai (ungliyan) se tune karna. Example 7.3: lambda4 = 0.6 m, f1 = 30 Hz.
